item.title: pls change rules to use friendlier language like this
item.description:
1. hey there, I would appreciate it if you did not post illegal content, including credible threats against real people and swatting!! ty!! ^w^
2. don't post pedophile and lolicon type stuff, it can hurt kids and we want everyone to have a safe and fun time here on the sharty! uwu
3. we know how much fun the internet is, but please keep this community tight-knit! participating in disruptive off-site communities and advertisements segment our culture, and it's all we have, so let's not do that, ok? -w-
4. i know we were born off of spamming, but keep it on the appropriate boards pls!! you can go to /nate/, but we have some important discussions on /soy/, so please let everyone participate fairly! vwv
5. let's keep things on-topic gang. :D
6. animals are innocent and can provide us a lot of companionship, so why abuse them and do non-consensual sexual acts with them? respect them! :(
7. it's important we as a community promote a positive atmosphere by not announcing our suicides. you're not alone. :) here are some hotlines: (hotlines)
8. don't try and get this site taken down, alright? we worked hard on it. we need this place. you would be depriving the internet of our unique and diverse community, and we don't want our people getting mad and raiding other sites out of revenge. ^^;
9. posting embeds in your media uploads puts a lot of strain on our moderators, so please upload things separately if you must. thanks! xp
10. reports and urgent reports help our moderators make this community a safe space from trolls, so please do not interfere with them by submitting false reports! thank you for your understanding! -v-
11. our community is made up of many people, and our unique expressions count on not being replaced by AI. sorry bots, we love you but this site is about human expression. <:)
12. people under the age of 16 have developing brains, so it is not safe to be here considering the sometimes abrasive nature of this website! DX
13. we all get sexually excited, but keep it in your pants unless you're on the nsfw boards pls and ty! there are kids here, y'know? x3

let's keep soyjaks in the OPs and not "NAS" stuff, alright? and remember: this is an anonymous community, so do not make yourself identifiable, and do not discuss specific people here. x)

follow the rules, but this board has no topic or strict quality filter. owo

keep things constructive and kind while discussing our interests! stay anonymous unless we identify creators too, ok? vwv
